author: /root/application_probe_audit
body:
Read-only restricted-domain-v2 audit complete. Actionable finding: early pair-level unsupported returns have the wrong scope for restricted-domain-v2. In `src/ladon/_proof_contract_probe_pair.py:106-111`, `unsupported_result` special-cases only `witness-dependence-v2` and otherwise emits `closed-nat-regularity-v1`; thus restricted-domain-v2 requests that hit `different-application-context` or nonempty `objectMap` at lines 96-101 receive the wrong profile scope instead of `closed-nat-zero-restricted-domain-v2`. No authority is granted, but this mislabels the unsupported result. Add domain-v2 scope and a native test for each early gate.

Otherwise no actionable matcher issue found: parser admits only universal Nat x and exact P(x) or `(x ≤ 0) → P(x)`, with exact var IDs, numeral 0, exact one-argument app, and closed same Nat→Prop symbol row. Side contracts require exact forall telescope, no assumptions, unknown regularity/constant dependencies and no witness dependencies; pair metadata and symbol mapping equality are checked. The shared native pair enforces own contract/source-map/interpretation owners, regenerated correspondences, common environment, exact slice/object map and empty object map. Goals preserve original formulas, formalize right reading against actual type, select implication vs conjunction-negation by direction/kind, hash exact text, and remain open/no-authority. Restricted-domain-v1 still dispatches through legacy unsupported path.

Test gaps beyond the scope finding: no native slice/object-map mismatch coverage; no same symbol ID with differing Lean name; no contract telescope/assumption/feature mismatches; no exact goal digest/open authority assertions; v1 test checks only unsupported/no goals rather than the full legacy result shape. Source/contract endpoint-to-P-symbol linkage is also not explicit in this matcher: pair checks endpoint/conclusion equality across sides, but not that those IDs denote the parsed P symbol; consider pinning this relationship if the v2 contract requires it.

Current SHA-256: `_proof_contract_probe_domain_ast.py` ff5e5f75176e83f416c14dc527036ba91bdee3f9284d4b4d539faeb1b28894f3; `_proof_contract_probe_domain_contracts.py` 28f39d9253c7d3146ac6e8faad82bb209b063e9f15f7219ef29ea9b1e33ac2b5; `_proof_contract_probe_domain.py` 8015df136adaa04e4d2876218210a620701789f7387689499ada32e82a7772d3; `_proof_contract_probe_templates.py` 8c05ef74c21e4bf193253d6467081f70cddf992a403b3a861e9692f57e0371bb; `_proof_contract_probe_pair.py` b4ee2d06e76850246439360466ac7cf15e95f43effe7cc75c51148a0ee0f75e0; frozen replacement test `test_proof_contract_restricted_domain_contract.py` 063e8268ce205a7f679a6a1939fc6f320bcfb7ad62d44601e9f7ad621380a787. No tests/proofs run or edits made.

author: /root/application_probe_audit
body:
Final endpoint-binding review complete. The tightened check is internally consistent for this deliberately narrow profile: the parsed AST `symbolId` is the same `P` used by both source-bound interpretation records and its identical `Nat → Prop` Lean mapping; each side's own contract is source-map-bound to that interpretation, and both contracts must agree exactly. Requiring both `endpointId` and `conclusionId` to equal `predicate:` + that parsed ID prevents a shared-but-unrelated endpoint/conclusion from admitting goals. The v3 regression exercises that shared unrelated-ID case; positive fixture and qualification script use `predicate:P` for AST ID `P`. No remaining false-acceptance path found in this check.

Scope note: this is safe but intentionally restrictive because the generic contract schema allows arbitrary identifiers; a legitimate source owner using a different endpoint naming convention will be rejected. That is a false negative/qualification limitation, not a false acceptance, and fits the declared exact profile if the naming convention remains part of its contract.

Hashes: `_proof_contract_probe_domain_contracts.py` `7d493b9789439b09a3200bb34d36d9e370f945a0ea83f6db2188ce74d852509e`; v3 replacement test `4e74f4fc77e3c5b6ae95095e993d61b7f05cb08c3929f8347e10b054ee9879c8`; qualification script `37f1141c8b70f5ce7233f66281baf0d948dd1e19f81968e59dac98e516c52d53`.
